channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: Archify
item.description: An agent skill for generating verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as self-contained HTML. — It allows AI coding agents to produce clear and verifiable visual documentation, which enhances the understanding and communication of complex AI-generated system designs.

item.title: Kith
item.description: Kith generates clinical notes for therapists using AI from ambient session audio. — This tool automates the laborious task of note-taking in clinical settings, streamlining workflows more efficiently than traditional transcription services.

item.title: Speko
item.description: Speko is an 'OpenRouter for Voice AI' platform, providing a unified API to access various voice AI models. — It simplifies integrating voice capabilities by offering a single interface to multiple providers, similar to how OpenRouter aggregates LLM APIs for developers.

item.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
item.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is an open-weight 30B mixture-of-experts model optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in long-running AI agents. — This model provides a cost-efficient and customizable open-weight solution for self-hosted inference, delivering faster output and agentic task completion for specialized workflows.

item.title: MoneyPrinterTurbo
item.description: A tool that generates high-definition short videos from a given topic or keyword using large AI models and automated workflows. — It offers a complete workflow for AI video creation, including native audio, which simplifies the process of producing high-quality video content compared to tools requiring separate audio integration.

item.title: Semantica
item.description: Semantica provides graph-native infrastructure for managing context and ensuring accountability in AI systems. — It offers a structured approach to agent memory and context management using a graph database, which can enhance the reasoning and reliability of AI agents compared to simpler vector stores.

item.title: AirLLM
item.description: AirLLM is an open-source library for efficient LLM inference on consumer-grade GPUs. — Pick this over Ollama when you need an inference engine focused on maximizing throughput and memory efficiency on consumer-grade GPUs, rather than a general local model runner.

item.title: DeepSeek V4-Flash
item.description: DeepSeek V4-Flash is an open-weight 284 billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model, officially released for agentic capabilities and efficient long-context processing. — This model significantly improves agentic performance at a lower cost than larger models, making it a strong choice for agent builders and long-context pipelines.
